items.summary: Authentication bypass in the JSON API Auth WordPress plugin via cached session cookie disclosure in all versions up to and including 3.1.2, letting unauthenticated attackers hijack sessions. Update the plugin immediately; no public exploit confirmed yet.

Missing authentication in Mooncake (through 0.3.13.post1) HTTP metadata server /metadata handler, allowing unauthenticated attackers to read, overwrite, and delete transfer-engine metadata keys. Upgrade Mooncake; the flaw is directly reachable without credentials.
Improper access control in Apache Traffic Server affecting 9.0.0–9.2.14 and 10.0.0–10.1.3. Upgrade to 9.2.15+ or 10.1.4+; reverse proxies and CDN edge nodes running ATS are the exposed surface.

Stored XSS in the WHM Mass Modify Accounts interface allowing arbitrary code execution, disclosed Oct 2 alongside cPanel/WHM security releases. Apply the vendor-patched cPanel build; reported via HackerOne.
